args.lesson: Fixture parity (33/33 on valid official inputs) did not cover invalid-input handling. A port can match the reference implementation byte for byte on good data and still fail on malformed data. Reviews of date or number parsers should always include boundary inputs (impossible dates, out-of-range time fields, out-of-range offsets) run against both the port and the reference. Close a superseded review mission promptly so it does not hold an expired lease.
